b300_followup_trigger: Consider a B300 feature-router draft only if the early-label selector shows a substantial, persistent late advantage over fixed controls and a separate label-blind probe can predict its choices. This is an advancement criterion, not a universal stop rule.

r3.ancestry: source-qualified exposed F0 callback replay; labels used only for official metric

tl3.ancestry: unknown; potentially trained on F0/validation, so predictions and any local scores are fitted diagnostics, not clean-CV evidence

interpretation_limits: F0 is repeatedly exposed and TL3 ancestry is unknown; this is not clean-CV evidence.
Expert choices use validation labels, which the test callback does not receive. This is not an online method or submission candidate.
The late-label selector is hindsight on its scoring segment and is not a formal upper bound for globally pooled WP.
Bootstrap intervals condition on the fixed caches and early selector choices; they do not capture training-seed, fitting, feedback-maturity or public-transfer uncertainty.
A positive screen would motivate a separate label-blind router or verified-feedback experiment; a weak result does not close the broader online-learning family.

panel.exposure: Repeatedly inspected/exposed F0; R3 was selected using F0 and TL3 ancestry is unknown, so scores may be fitted diagnostics and are not clean validation or transfer evidence.

question: Does a sequence-specific choice between fixed TL3 and R3 experts using early scored rows remain useful on later rows?

resources.admission_policy: Use the durable bandit_resources controller; profile eight groups first, then run the full frozen panel under the same reservation.

selection_rule.early_rule: For each sequence and target, choose the expert with higher official local WP on scored positions 99 through 4999; exact ties choose TL3.
selection_rule.late_rule: Freeze the early choice on positions 5000 through 19999. Also calculate a late-label hindsight selector on that same late segment as a diagnostic only.
selection_rule.score_mask: target-cache official is_scored mask AND position >= 99
selection_rule.target_maturity: Unknown; no label feedback is assumed to be available to the test callback.

split.source: source-qualified fold0 evaluation groups; component membership verified before target-cache access

targets.open_order: Only after recipe/code/contract/split/prediction/sidecar hashes and prediction shapes pass.

why_it_might_work: If distinct experts correct different sequence regimes, a label-informed early selector may identify persistent per-sequence advantage and motivate a feature-derived teacher target.
